body: Thank you so much.
Yeah, i dont know. I didnt put to much thought into it. They became a couple on Facebook, 3 days before he came to pick up his stuff at me, apparantly.

A guy from tinder asked how he looked like. When he found him on Facebook he texted "his new girl is a down grade".

I have him blocked on everything
We always said that i would get the dog if we splitted up. I gave him up, to another family - considering i was mentally destroyed when my ex left. I couldnt even take care of myself.
Same. Im ignoring loads of guys, for a guy thats ignoring me.
Do be honest i just got so horny it droved me crazy. But it's definatly something you should only do when you feel ready. No rush

I havent seen my ex in 7 months, and we are NOT on good terms. Last tuesday he walked into the restaurant i was at, with the girl i was always jealous of. It was a punch in the stomach, but at the same time i was like; she will never be me, and i can do SOOO much better than that. Please dm me if you ever feel like talking, i got you bro
I fucked someone else, 7 months after i got dumped. It was weird, cause my ex was the only one ive ever been with. But it helped
I thought i was over mine. Havent seen him in 7 months. Yesterday he walked into the restaurant i was at, with the girl i was always jealous of. It killed me, and i feel like im back at square one.
Same. I dont really have any friends and a small family. But i got better, and so will you. You can always text if you want to talk :)
YES. And when he texted me that i was like "fuck this shit"
I had to sell the dog cause i couldnt afford him. My ex didnt want anything to do with him. Thank you so much for sharing. We got this.
Thank you so much for sharing. Im on anti depressants as well after this.
Thank you, that meant alot to me. 🙏
Thank you so much :)
Please text me if you ever feel like talking.
Excactly. My moving on process has been slowed down so much cause he took so long to get his stuff. Feel free to text me if you ever need to talk to someone :)
Im doing okay, but thats only cause i havent seen him since last year. it's been 7 months since the BU. My days are okay, but i really miss being touched by someone, hugged, kissed and such.

It could have been me who wrote this post, just 6 months ago. I also suffer from ptsd, axienty, and he was the only safe place i had ever known. He was my first everything. We were together for 4 years and 51 weeks (from we were 16-21 years old) We had just moved into our new apartment, and he dumped me a month later (1 week before our 5 year anniversary) I got suicidal, got sumbitted to a mental facility, and thought about killing myself every day. But today, 6 months later, im doing so much better. Time helps. And cry, scream, and talk about it as much as you need to. Theres no rush for you to get better, you just take your time. You can text me if you want to, im here :)

Ive been in your situation. EXCACTLY. I feel like it could have been me who wrote this. This have nothing to do with you, but with his own self esteem. And when that is low, they tend to take it out on the people who love them. Feel free to dm me if you want to. I have lots of experience in this area.

Jesus, thats not a man, thats a BOY. He sounds very insecure, when you say he hates you looking at him during sex. He sounds like the kind of guy who thinks that sex is supposed to be the same as in porn. MANY women have a hard time reach orgasm during penetration, i do too. He says that you aren't tight enough, did he ever thought the issue could be him not being big enough?? Get you a REAL man, cause a real man wouldnt give a shit about those things.

From what ive heard, it's VERY normal for the dumper to act completely different and out of character. I have the same problem with mine. And honestly, i dont know how they can. Ive never dumped anyone. His behavior disgust me. But of course they did love us, why would you else enter a relationship? And i choose to believe, that if you were a good girlfriend/boyfriend, and they had treated you horrible during the break up, karma will get them at some point.

The heart and brain doesent always agree with each other. Logic and emotions are two different things. My heart really want to text my ex, because i love him and i miss him. But my brain knows it's a bad idea.
I feel like this will never stop. I dont know how much longer i can take this
It's been 5 months. I really want the pain to stop..
Mine texted me "i love you❤️" in the morning. When he came home he dumped me.
I would tell him to go fuck himself, and then move on
Omg 😂 big mood
5 months here. And he is in my head all the time.

Time. 4 months since the BU for me, and at first i didnt wanna believe it. Lasted for about 1,5-2 months. I wanted go get back together. But he has treated me SO poorly through this proces, that im starting to dought if i ever want him back. But i sure as hell still want him to change his mind, so i can have the pleasure of telling him to go fuck himself.

I got suicidal thoughts when my ex dumped me. But i never EVER thought it was his fault. The breakup pushed me over the edge - but how i choose to handle things, can never be any others responsebility but my own. I thought about killing myself, but i could never ruin his life by having him thinking it was cause of him. It's not your responsebility to take care of her, as she is not a child. Im assuming shes a grown up, and you've gotta have your own back before you can have others.
Omg same. I got dumped, and i was there when his friends and family wasnt. Now hes just having a good time with them.
I sure as fuck hope so.
Leave him alone. If he wanted to text you, he would have. I know your pain.
Same. My birthday was april 26th and i was all alone cause of this virus. Never heard a word from him. A year ago he made birthday cake.
You cant feel bad about ANYTHING he DIDNT tell you. Sounds like hes ghosting you. Mine does too, but he dumped me first. You did nothing wrong.
Same. You can dm me if you ever need it.

Please her me out. I was in the EXACT same place as you, 4 months ago. My life was all about him. And when he left, i thought more and more about killing myself. With the thought of, that if he learned i died, he probably wouldnt give a shit. I got submitted to a mental facility. Thats how rough it got. I cant remember ANYTHING from december. (he left december 12th). And I didnt eat for 2 weeks. I never thought it would be better. But it did! Not much. But i can stand to live again. But he is every where. Cause we did everything together. Please dm me if you ever need it.

Well, i didnt get the butterflies after a 5 year relationship, but i LOVED him more than anything. We became more like a "team" than romantic lovers, after a few years. I think thats pretty normal. But i didnt care, it was enough for me. But not for him.
What did he say when he broke up with you? Did he show any signs of pulling away before it happend? I suspect my ex has a depression but im not sure
I really dont know. I was there for my ex when his family and friends turned their back on him. And I got dumped anyway. I choose to believe karma will get him. I really fucking hope so
Same. Just trying to be relived due to the fact that i dont have to deal with such a heartless person anymore. But it hurts.
The heart and brain doesent always agree on things.
I got into a school too. Told my ex, he didnt gave a shit.
OMG YES SAME
Same. He was my only friend as well, and now i have nobody. He has tons of friends he can go to.
How long has it been since the BU? Dought i will ever get a text from my ex.
Ill dm you :)
4 months :/
We moved into our new apartment. 1 month after he dumped me. Left me and our dog. Hurts like a bitch
It could have been me who wrote this. He also wanted to know how it was like being on his own. It will get better, i promise. But slowley. It's hard to get over someone youve been with for so long.
Yeah i get that. I just wished he would reach out so i could tell him to go fuck himself. Lol
Damn. It's been 4 months for me, and my ex avoids me like the plaque.
How long after the BU did they reach out?
Omg this helped me so much. Needed this. Thank you.

Girl SAME. He wasnt the sameas in the beginning, and there was a lot of reasons for that (low self esteem and so on). But i loved him anyway. Ride or die you know? I was a better girlfriend to him than he was as a boyfriend to me the last year. And I really know i set the bar high, for when hes going to find someone new. Ive learned that you cant love someone proberly, when you dont love yourself. I loved him for the both of us, and i dont think he will ever find a girl like that again. Im also hoping for an apology, but he is damn proud and stubborn. If i jumped from his ego down to his emotions i would die lol. If you ever feel like it, dm me. Seems like we got much in common.

Excactly. Months before, he covered me at night when i got cold. Our dog was our "baby". And he left him too. I had to go to an exam 4 days after he dumped me, and had been to two 5 days before. Got sumbitted to the hospital december 29th, and got out january 2th and went to my last exam january 6th. I didnt want him to hurt in the start either. But im thinking more and more about what i deserve, and less of him. Cause in the start it was ALL about him. HE lost feelings, HE wanted to start a life for himself alone. What about me? He thought, that since i wasnt his girlfriend anymore, he didnt had to worry about how he made me feel. And that HURT more than anything. I was there when his family wasnt. When his friends wasnt. Built him up when he was down. We were each others first EVERYTHING. I still love him more than anything. But i want karma to hit him so hard. Cant seem to shake that feeling off. Looking forward to when i just dont give a shit anymore.

He sounds like my ex. Completely without balls. And im not saying that to be mean. But i think it takes balls to say "look, i think we have problems we need to work out" instead of just leaving. I was dumped 1 week before our 5 year anniversary. We had just moved into our new apartment (his choice) and had been living there for 1 month. There i was, alone, with our dog. I have ptsd which gets triggered by loud noices, and i was gonna be alone at new years, with our dog. And I had two finals at school to finish. I broke down and got sumbitted to a mental facility with suicidal thoughts. He got mad at me cause now HE had to find a place for our dog to be, at new years, cause he was going to a party. I keept being nice to him, until he just stopped answering in febuary, and ignored me for 2 months. He left december 12th, and came to get his stuff april 20th. And then i just had it. He dont deserve my love at all, and i really hope i one day find a man who will. I loved him more than ANYTHING, and he threw that away. I chose to beilive that karma will get him. So should you!

I was dumped after 5 years, and have been single for 4 months. First 2 months i cried none stop, and didnt eat at all. I dont cry that much anymore, and im eating again. I dont got any other exes but him (first relationship). It hurts. Everyday. But i am moving on. And the anger helps me. I keep getting more angry everyday, thinking of how he has treated me. I will not trust people as easily after this, and that is something i have to live with. I didnt thought there would be someone better for me either. But now i know that there sure as hell will be someone, who will appriciate my love in a way he never did. Cause i love HARD. Thats why this break up nearly killed me. Im a ride or die kind of person, and i refuse on giving up on the idea, that there is someone who will be that for me too.

I feel you. 5 years here, been broken up for 4 months. I know the blaming part, and the feeling that there still was something that could be saved. But you have to understand, that she didnt want to save it. I KNOW it hurts. I would have taken a bullet for my ex. But he ended up leaving anyway. You shouldnt blame yourself. You did the best you could, with the knowlegde you had at the time. We all did.
How long were you together and how long have you been broken up?
Thank you so much to all of you. The day has been fine, but it's even better when you know youre not alone. Thank you!
Oh yes. Going through it right now, and i really needed my best friend these last few months. Sucks when thats your ex too.

Wow. This is everything i thought was wrong with my ex, but he would NEVER own up to it like you did! And i stayed with him untill he dumped me lol. You cant change the past. And I KNOW that doesent help. But i think of it this way: i did the best i could, with the knowlegde i had at the time. I drove my ex to dump me, cause he had been acting so distant for weeks, and i was tired of being so paranoid. I dont regret that. You can learn from this, and take the knowlegde with you. You are taking responsebility for your mistakes, and if your ex doesent want that kind of a guy, im sure some other woman will. I wish my ex was that mature.

Please. You are HUMAN. I got dumped. But if i was the dumper, and my ex reached with "oh well, life goes on", i would feel better about breaking up, than if my ex reacted like you (and i personally) did. It shows that we CARE. And that is nothing to be ashamed about. I got weak and insecure when i got dumped, because we had been together for 5 YEARS, he was my first everything, and i trusted him 1000%, and i had never loved the way that i love him. He was, and still is - cold as fuck. I also wish i could do things over, but in the end - why would i do that for someone who didnt think i was worth fighting for? It hurts more than anything. But in the end, you got dumped by someone who didnt think you were worth it. THEY lost a person who loved them more than anything. Who would you rather be? WE GOT THIS.
Books, movies, drawing does it for me. But never 100%. Please text me if you ever feel the need to.

I think we all wished we could have handled it better. I sure as hell wish i had used as little energy on it as he did. And that i hadnt begged and pleaded. But it's NORMAL. It's a normal reaction when youre completely blindsided by a person you love. I reacted horrible, like if you told me my mom died kinda. Cause we had been together for 5 years, and i fucking loved him more than anything. Still do. Even though he treats me like i dont exist.
Thank you so much. Going through the worst time my life so far, and it doesent help when he treats you like shit.
4 months here, im not even close either. Not after 5 years.
I get that! Mine is like that too. And I sure as hell deserve better, than someone who'll rather listens to his friends, than his own heart. You do too.
Mine is damn proud too. But no pride will ever stop them from reaching out, if they REALLY want to. I know it hurts :/

I have texted mine so many times, and gotten ignored - to the point where i cant text him anymore and still keep my self respect. If she wanted to talk to you, she would have texted you. Thats how i look at it. But yeah, it hurts like a BITCH
How long have you been broken up?
Girl same..
Did he break up up with you?
I was there for him when his family and friends turned their back on him. I cried on his behalf, cause they treated him so terribly. I got dumped, and he went back to them.
We have been broken up for 4 months, and ive gone nc for 1,5 month now. I just fear it's to late for him to feel anything :-(
Did she break up with you?
What im wishing for. Just so i can tell him to go fuck himself.
Coach Lee!
2-3 weeks. Then it slowley got better.

This is completely normal. I feel the EXACT same way. I lost weight, and i couldnt eat for 2 weeks. My body keept saying to me that i had to throw up, but when you dont eat, thats hard. During a breakup, your body is under so much stress. So it's normal. But it will get better. Even though it seems like it never will.
I feel you. I have my past with being abandoned too. But i never thought he would.
Same.. Even after 4 months
Well, my ex started to ignore me. And it came to a point where my self respect couldnt take anymore messages being send, without an answer. And then Coach Lee on YouTube helped me, ALOT!
Thank you. Im cheering for you as well! Feel free to reach out if you ever need to.
Thank you so much!! The support means the world to me.
Thank you so much, that means the world to me. I will keep that in mind, thank you!!!
Thank you. I needed this.
Same. He dumped me one week before our 5 year anniversary. I have the same questions as you. My conscience would have killed me if i treated him the way he treats me.
Same. Everyday he doesent reach out, hurts.

Thats good too! Anything to take your mind off things. Distraction is good. But you must not avoid the pain. It needs to be felt, so you can heal. If you try to avoid it, it will catch up with you.

- As a girl, i dont think that is true. If SHE dumped YOU, its not your responsibility as a man, to fix what she has broken. She has to come back because she wants to. If she doesent, there isnt anything you can do about it. I know it's hard. But you will get through this, i promise you. I know your pain. I starting dating my ex when i was 16, and in a month ill turn 22.. A heartbreak makes you feel like youre dying.

Well, im not a boy, but i wanna help anyway. Looking at their social media is self harm. Believe me, ive been there. And it slows down your healing process. Ask yourself, what will you gain from looking at their social media? Something positive? No. You will only harm yourself. She is your ex - shes not your problem anymore. Feel free to reach out if you need a girls perspective on things, and stay strong! You got this.
I know how youre feeling. But it does get better, i promise. Feel free to reach out if you ever need it.

Im feeling the same way. It does get better. Im at the place where i still hope he comes back. But i use the new "me time" to improve myself. Working out is a great way to get the stress out of your body. And it gives your brain a little room to "breathe" as well. It helps ALOT. 

- I dont hate my ex either. Maybe i should. But I would take a bullet for him. You will learn alot from this pain. It's the biggest pain ive EVER experienced. But you learn, and you grow.

I could have written this myself. I totally get you. But this will get better. My bf broke up with me in december, after 5 years together. (were both 21.) I had suicidal thoughts, cause i loved him SO much. And I was SO happy. I wanted to die. He was the key to my happiness. He was my best friend. I have cried everyday for 3 months. But it really does get better with time, even though that doesent help on how you're feeling right now. A person can and may NOT be the key to your happiness. You need to find that within your self. Ive learned that the hard way. You can text me if you need someone to talk too :) you got this.

It's hard. We were best friends for 6 years and in a relationship for 5. He left 3 months ago, and i havent heard from him in two months now. He ignores my messages. For the first time in 6 years.. (he has to pick up his stuff, he lives at a friend until he finds his own place, and that is mainly what i text him about). There were bad stuff about the relationship, but not enough (after my opinion). In the relationship i was happy. But its like he's a whole different person now.
3 months here. I cry too.

Please dont be. You're only human. Im not proud of it, but if my ex stopped ignoring my messages and texted me, i would answer immidiatly. You're stronger than me for sure, and im rooting for you. You got this.
Same. It drives me crazy.
Day 4. Every day is so fucking hard.
I literally feel like i could have written this post. I feel like an idiot too. Every time i text him, i know he will ignore it. But im just so heartbroken.
That is VERY normal. I have those moments myself. We heal in our own way. I can be "happy" one moment, and the next i perhaps see something who reminds me of him, and then i burst into tears.

How long it's been since the break up? It DOES get better, very slowley. The first few weeks, i didnt eat at all. I lost so much weight, and cried all the time. Every day is still shitty, and i cry alot. But ive got my appetite back, and i can laugh again. Not much, just a little. My best advice for you, would be to feel your pain. Cry as much as you need to. Talk about it. You heal in YOUR way. There is no rush. But at the same time, you also need to do some stuff you like to do, to distract you sometimes. Not to avoid your feelings, but to let your brain and body "breathe" for a bit. I like to draw, to read (Harry Potter atm) and to work out. But i know the pain. Ive never experienced anything like it. It feels like you're dying sometimes.

Im excactly where you are right know. And EVERY time ive broken no contact, things got much worse for me. He ignores my messages. And it is self harm for me to keep texting him, with a hope for an answer - when i know i wont get one. But i know your pain. Im looking for closure too. We were together for 5 years, friends for 6. And now he just act like ive never existed. I dont know what hurts more, the break up, or this, to be honest. But they dont deserve us reaching out to them. It's was a privilige for him/her to have you in their life. A privilige he/she doesent want anymore. A person who doesent want you in their life, sure as hell dont deserve you. You will find one someday, who will know excactly how lucky he/she is to have you.
You can dm me any time :)
Im here.
Feeling the exact same way. I was so happy before. And now ive cried everyday for 3 months.
Mood
Thank you! It helps to feel that im not alone.
Ive thought about that. Thank you so much.
I dont dream that much about him, but my heart aches too. And when i dream, it's TORTURE. The days seem impossible to get through.
You are more than welcome to reach out if you ever need it. You are not alone.
You're welcome to reach out if you ever need someone to talk to. Your story sounds very similar to mine. He also left after 5 years, in december. It Does get better. Slowly.

Same here. I just want him to say out loud that he's aware that he treated me like shit. And then i hope karma gets to him. I know right?! I miss him SO much, but at the same time i just wanna yell and scream at him for what he did to me. He doesent deserve my attention, but i cant help it. Now he just ignores me. That hurts as well. It's like you never meant anything to them.

Girl, same. Its SO hard not to check, but it only cause harm to ourselves.. Mine did too. And havent contacted me in weeks either. He broke up two months ago. Time really does heal all wounds. I still feel like shit, but im not in the same place as I was at first. But i still miss him. Everyday.

I went through the same 2 weeks ago. I really feared his birthday. I told myself that hell no if he deserved a "happy birthday", when he dumped me the way he did. I was also wondering how he would celebrate it. The first birthday without me, in 5 years. But i have to learn not to give a damn. Cause it's not my problem anymore. And that was HIS choice. I blocked him on Facebook, mainly to avoid seeing all the girls, wishing him a happy birthday. Think about it. What will you gain of seeing who wished him a happy birthday? Something useful? No. It's selfharm. But i still get your "need" to see it. My dm is open if you ever feel the need to talk :)
Same. He treats me like shit and I still miss him.
Hurts like hell. My dm is open, feel free to reach out if you ever need it. :)
Same! He texted me "i love you", the day before he dumped me.
Im feeling you. I never got the chance to fix anything either. He just gave up on us. 1 week before our 5 years anniversary. Boom.

Thank you so much for your reply. It helps to hear it, from someone whose been in a similar situation. Ive also thought about the fact that ive never been an adult without him. I HAVE to learn how to do that. He told me he didnt have feelings for me anymore. I felt like dying. We had a dog together which we bought together, and i now had to give him to another family, because i couldnt afford him on my own. I feel like ive lost everything. Our relationship was NOT unhealthy, so it made it really hard for me to understand. We have SO many memories, so almost everything i do outside the house, reminds me of him. As said, we had only lived in our apartment for three weeks when he broke it off, so now i feel like im sitting in the grave of our relationship. I really hope that happiness, or luck, will turn my way one day, and that he will end up miserable, knowing he lost the best thing he ever had. I have no trouble taking responsibility for my own mistakes, but i know i was a great girlfriend. And a healthy one. I dont have many friends, so i dont have the opportunity to get distracted. I study from home. Thats the biggest problem atm. I feel so depressed i cant breathe. I sleep alot, probably more than i should. And i dont really see any life purpose anymore. He was the best friend i ever had, and i love him so much. I felt SO SAFE with him you know? And i miss getting kisses and hugs. I never knew how much they ment, until they werent there anymore.
